requirements.title: Review protocol
requirements.content: The reviewer must receive neutral evidence before author rationale.

implementationPlan.title: Architecture and roadmap
implementationPlan.content: Define versioned contracts before their consumers.

authorPacket.intent: Establish the first runtime contract boundary.
successCriteria: Author content remains a separately typed field.
authorPacket.technicalApproach: Use one strict Zod schema as the runtime and type source.

componentWalkthrough.changes: Validate request identity, canonical inputs, and author packet separation.

decisions.rationale: This is the accepted review default.
alternatives: Require callers to repeat the default.

invariants: Author content is never merged into canonical inputs.
risks: Later packet limits must bound large text inputs.
knownGaps: Snapshot capture is not part of this slice.
challengePoints: Check whether the contract is strict enough at every nested boundary.
